• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

Got a first working experience, and looking to expand your horizons? As a Junior Customer Service Representative for the Emerging Markets at a multinational medical devices and healthcare company, you'll be the primary point of contact for their valued customers (hospitals, distributors, buying groups, ...).

What you'll do:

• Order processing, either manual or via an internal platform
• Maintain various master data (customers, prices, materials, ...) in SAP in order to ensure data accuracy and streamline processes to keep the data up to date
• Address customer concerns by executing root cause investigations and offering solutions (replacements, corrective invoices, ...)
• Issue credit/debit memos
• Support inventory management activities

• You're fluent in English and intermediate to proficient in either Russian, French or Arab
• You have a first experience in a similar role
• Upper secondary diploma/high school diploma

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Jobomschrijving

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

Our client is a leading international industrial group headquartered in Belgium. To support several members of the Executive Committee, the company is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant in Brussels.

As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level administrative and organisational support to three C-levels, allowing them to focus on strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing calendars and organizing meetings.
• Coordinating business travel arrangements.
• Preparing and formatting presentations, reports and other business documents.
• Supporting leadership meetings, events and training sessions.
• Anticipating executives' needs and ensuring smooth follow-up on key actions.
• Providing ad hoc administrative support on strategic initiatives.

• You are looking for a first experience or already have a few years of experience as Management Assistant or Executive Assistant.
• You are fluent in French and English, with a good understanding of Dutch.
• You are organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• You are comfortable working autonomously and taking initiative.
• You communicate professionally and confidently with senior stakeholders.
• You are flexible, service-oriented and eager to learn.
